
## backdown license add {#add}

Check a licence key (offline) and keep it in your BackDown data folder.

```text
backdown license add [OPTIONS] <KEY>
```

### Arguments

`<KEY>`
: The key from your order confirmation (BD1.…), or - to read it from stdin.

## backdown license show {#show}

Show the licence you have (exits 1 without one)

```text
backdown license show [OPTIONS]
```

All of them also take the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

The key is checked offline, on this machine, and kept in your BackDown data folder. `show` exits 1 when there's no licence.

## Examples

```sh
backdown license add BD1.eyJ2Ijox…
# or from a file or the clipboard, on stdin
backdown license add - < licence.txt
backdown license show
```
